criteria.text: The macOS packaging pipeline includes the correct multi-resolution Rhythm icon and sets the bundle icon metadata to that resource.
criteria.test_id: Rhythm icon: assembly maps every source slot and inventories the converter output

criteria.text: The packaged app's primary icon is the Rhythm icon, with no fallback to the generic Electron icon.
criteria.test_id: rhythm-icon: packaged plist references the Rhythm artwork, with no Electron fallback

criteria.text: A freshly packaged/installed app displays the Rhythm icon in Finder, Dock, Command-Tab, and Get Info, at normal and Retina sizes.
criteria.reason: Requires packaged-app inspection in Finder, Dock, Command-Tab, and Get Info.

criteria.text: The release pipeline uses the same icon assembly step; the icon is present before app signing/notarization, with no post-signing bundle modification.
criteria.test_id: Rhythm icon: packaging and release assemble icons before bundle signing

criteria.text: Packaging fails clearly if the required Rhythm artwork or generated icon is absent/invalid.
criteria.test_id: Rhythm icon: rejects missing mapping before conversion

criteria.text: Add a focused packaging regression check for the referenced icon resource and Rhythm artwork identity/content, not merely the existence of an arbitrary `.icns` file.
criteria.test_id: rhythm-icon: packaged plist references the Rhythm artwork, with no Electron fallback
